promotional_text: 一键聚合 Google、百度、YouTube、B站等 40+ 平台，支持语音搜索、多标签、广告拦截和自定义平台，搜索更快更私密。

Added manual element blocking so you can pick ads or page clutter and restore rules per site. Improved browsing with external-app confirmations, multi-tab controls, a new tab page, Find in Page, desktop mode, smoother downloads, sharing, and link menus. Voice search, clipboard prompts, suggestions, platform management, batch import, and wallpaper refresh have also been refined.
